text.title: Families in Moscow who order groceries for the week
text.useful: Empty fridge on a workday: no time to shop
text.unique: Pickers scan a live stock map, so no surprise substitutes
text.specific: Delivery in 2 hours; 98% on time in June; free above 1 500 ₽
text.urgent: Free delivery for the first 3 orders until 30 September
text.phrase: Groceries in 2 hours, or the delivery is on us
text.risk: The 98% figure covers June only; the 2-hour promise may fail in heavy rain
text.check: Share of orders on time and refund requests per 100 orders, reviewed every 2 weeks
text.decision: Publish on the home page from 1 October. Confirm the on-time figure with July data
